notes.title: Class Update: v1.61
notes.notes:
Hail Warriors!

Welcome back to all our warriors out to raid at PAX West. This week, we have some long awaited changes that you'll absolutely love:

This week's changes:

NEW CHARACTER -The Wolf Priestess: a healer type class with  range to deal magic damage from afar. 
NEW CHARACTER -The Iron Breaker: a tank class with high block chances to leave your enemies feeling humiliated. Also, a hammer to bash their skulls in!
A MAKEOVER - The Valkyrie now has a new look. A few streamers had compared her to a lovely lady ready to serve "a fancy a cup of tea". *Developers flip the table*. The Valkyrie now looks like a Viking ready to floss your bones with her spear.
Added one new enemy called: the Master Assassin.
While in combat, we added an icon next to your health bar, so that you can see how many move points your crew has left.
Further game balance tweaking with dodge and critical hit chances.
You can also spend Glory to re-roll the warriors in the Great Hall. 


Looking for Linux Testers
Unfortunately, we've experienced some hiccups in development that leaves our friend Linux behind in the dust. If you are a Linux user, we have a post in the discussions board where you can work with us to be help us be a beta tester in preparation of Full Launch.

We're Connected to you through Twitch
We noticed a live stream of Iron Tides this weekend happening through Twitch. If any warriors out there have a Let's Play account on Twitch, feel free to add us as CrashWaveGames! We're happy to stop by during your stream and check out what you're up to. 

All feedback and reviews are welcome!
